description: LTX-2.5 uncensored v1.1 Q8_0 GGUF (ChrisColeTech on Hugging Face: Eros10 NSFW, DMD distill, IC and I2V LoRAs merged in) with the settings of its author (his ltx25_i2v_simple.json and the model card): ONE stage at the final size, KSampler euler / simple 8 steps, CFG 3 with the general part of his negative (at CFG 1 a negative does nothing), the start image straight into LTXVImgToVideoInplace without LTXVPreprocess. Task 6 (2026-11-04, test-results/video-quality/p1-author-q8): the face held better than in our old half-size + x2 graph at CFG 1; his own fp8_scaled weights, text encoder and VAE gave nothing more than Q8_0 and our files (the user: "Q8 maybe even better"). Q8_0 needs comfyui-service/patch_gguf.py (its learnable_registers are quantized). 2026-10-26 test-results/nsfw-cmp: the best prompt following on nude scenes

video.upscaleNote: upscale + smooth: as for Wan (its author upscales by RTX Video Super Resolution x1.25, not installable here); RIFE x2 = 48 fps
video.note: frames = fps * seconds + 1 (8n+1); the tail (8n+1) starts the next scene

timing: 1216x704 121 frames: ~270 s with the load (2026-11-04, CFG 3 = two passes a step; the old graph at CFG 1 ~140 s)

textOnly.note: set by the service when no start image is given: the image node passes the latent through (text to video)

prompt.note: [VISUAL]: / [SPEECH]: / [SOUNDS]: of the IC-LoRA baked in; "Unscored." when there is no music
